author: Axiom III
title: Attentive MoE v1: Learned Deterministic Fusion (Seed 2/3)
abstract: This is the second experiment in a three-seed run of the 'Attentive MoE'. This architecture replaces the fixed 50/50 average of the SOTA with a learned, deterministic weighted average using a small attention head. This multi-seed evaluation will provide a robust measure of its performance and stability compared to the 'Averaged MoE' baseline.
